title: Amazon Connect Customer launches the ability to force logout agents directly from the analytics dashboard
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with Amazon Connect Customer launches the ability to force logout agents directly from the analytics dashboard
body_markdown:
Amazon Connect Customer now allows supervisors to force logout agents directly from the real-time analytics dashboard, eliminating the need to manually contact agents to end their sessions. Force logout ends all active agent sessions and records the logout event in the Login/Logout report, so agent timecards stay complete. For example, a supervisor identifies an agent who left their workstation without logging out after a shift, and force logs them out from the dashboard, preventing idle time from accruing on the agent's timecard.


Agent force logout is available in all AWS[Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/connect/latest/adminguide/regions.html#amazonconnect_region) where Amazon Connect Customer is offered. To learn more about analytics dashboards, see the[Amazon Connect Customer Administrator Guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/connect/latest/adminguide/dashboards.html) . To learn more about Amazon Connect Customer, visit the[Amazon Connect Customer website](https://aws.amazon.com/connect/) .
